experiences.title: Marketing Operations Analyst (GTM)
experiences.description:
Improved marketing reporting efficiency by 45% by analyzing website traffic, engagement, and conversion funnels in GA4 and HubSpot, then building Power BI dashboards that pinpointed funnel drop-off points
Enriched and segmented inbound leads with Clay and HubSpot workflows, syncing enriched fields into reporting to track lead-to-opportunity conversion and lifting lead data completeness by 60% for sharper targeting
Engineered self-service Power BI and Tableau dashboards on multi-source data across 5+ reporting workflows, replacing manual report prep and documenting each dashboard's data lineage for end-to-end metric traceability
Shortened reporting turnaround by 25% by leading requirements workshops that aligned stakeholders on metric definitions, then translating them into clear, build-ready Power BI report specifications

experiences.title: GTM Engineer
experiences.description:
Cut manual data processing effort by 40% by engineering Python (Pandas) ETL pipelines with automated data-cleansing logic that kept data accurate and consistent across 5+ production environments
Powered targeted sales outreach by automating lead enrichment and prospect segmentation with Apollo, Python, and SQL, orchestrating n8n and REST API workflows that pushed scored accounts into the CRM
Slashed manual lead triage by 50% by designing and tuning OpenAI API prompt workflows that classify and route inbound leads by intent and firmographic fit, getting high-value accounts to sales faster
Lowered downstream escalations by 25% by building reusable Python frameworks that reconcile data discrepancies across systems and running end-to-end UAT on data products to catch schema issues before release

experiences.title: Growth Analyst
experiences.description:
Reduced data pipeline errors by 20% by analyzing ERDs and database models to develop Teradata SQL ETL mappings that traced every source field to its target table, giving analysts dependable data for growth reporting
Standardized growth tracking across 3+ business units with Power BI dashboards built on defined metric logic and data-quality controls, then surfaced upsell targets via funnel, cohort, and RFM analyses on Salesforce data
Translated stakeholder requirements into data products with PostgreSQL, Python cleansing pipelines, and Tableau, then automated report refreshes through Zapier and Power Automate, cutting manual effort by 60%
